# Crossword builder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/crossword/

Arrange your own answers and clues into a connected crossword and export a numbered puzzle with an answer page.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Enter short science terms with clues and generate a classroom practice crossword.

## Limits and checks

The layout needs intersecting letters. Unconnected entries are reported instead of silently omitted; add bridging words or try another layout.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
